name: multi_session
description: Facts and decisions accumulated across many sessions; recall the correct historical decision among similar-looking distractors. Tests cross-session long-horizon recall.

items.text: Decided to use the LSM engine for durable local memory.
items.subject: storage

items.text: Decided to avoid adding the AWS SDK; use a stdlib SigV4 signer instead.
items.subject: deps

items.text: Agreed the tenant prefix format is tenant/<id>/.
items.subject: tenant

items.text: Chose gRPC as the default protocol for memory testing.
items.subject: protocol

items.text: Set the scheduled persistence period to 10 seconds.
items.subject: persistence

items.text: The build needs CGO_ENABLED=0 on this macOS to avoid an LC_UUID linker error.
items.subject: build

items.text: S3 cloud mode must fail fast when the bucket is missing.
items.subject: cloud

items.text: Memory keys live under /_memory/ and are further prefixed with /_data/ at the server.
items.subject: keys

queries.text: Why didn't we use the AWS SDK?
What storage engine did we pick for durability?
